title: The Regent's dialogue offers 'name Vell's blood to the Regent (Vell -2)' as an ordinary, always-available menu entry once the secret is known, with no confirmation step — a single misclick this late could unilaterally out a trusted companion's deepest, freely-confided secret for a flat -2 regard, which felt like an outsized risk for a one-line menu pick.
where: The Regent's Chambers, Marrowgate / talk to Regent Ysolde
